## Interactive Case Studies & Live Artifacts
Instead of static claims, explore these verifiable builds and architectures:

### 1. Uber-Microservices | Distributed Ride Matching System
- **Live Code / Proof:** https://github.com/karansundariya/Uber-Microservices
- **Problem Solved:** Coordinates ride requests across hundreds of moving drivers with ultra-low latency without database row-lock contention or cascading HTTP failures.
- **Architecture / Stack:** Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Redis Geospatial (GEOADD / GEORADIUS), MySQL, Docker Compose.
- **Verified Outcome:** Decouples ride booking from driver dispatch using Kafka event topics, achieves sub-millisecond candidate proximity lookups via Redis spatial skip lists, and manages deterministic 5-state ride transitions.

### 2. JobLex | Full-Stack Campus Recruitment Platform
- **Live URL:** https://joblex-vo9q.onrender.com/
- **Code Repo:** https://github.com/karansundariya/JobLex
- **Problem Solved:** Centralizes fragmented campus placement workflows with automated listing expiry and role-based access control.
- **Architecture / Stack:** React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB compound indexing, Tailwind CSS, JWT & bcrypt.
- **Verified Outcome:** Production web app with role-based dashboards (Student, Recruiter, Admin), compound-indexed multi-filter query speed, and automatic background cleanup of expired listings.

### 3. CVNirmaan AI | Intelligent Resume Architect
- **Live URL:** https://cvnirmaan-ai.vercel.app
- **Code Repo:** https://github.com/karansundariya/CVNirmaan_AI
- **Problem Solved:** Automates candidate profile tailoring with prompt guardrails enforcing strict ATS-compliant JSON output.
- **Architecture / Stack:** React.js, Google Gemini API, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore.
- **Verified Outcome:** Real-time reactive preview and deterministic, print-ready vector PDF exports matching industry recruiter dimensions.
